idle: Not started. Press Run or Step forward to watch key {key} go from the root down to a leaf.
noPath: The data read has no path for this key, so the animation cannot run. The tree is still shown correctly.
reducedNote: Reduced motion is on: each step changes instantly, with no transition.
summaryHeap: Path of key {key}: pages {pages}, then a jump to heap page {heap}.

step.internal: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}). Key {key} belongs to the branch from {lo} up to before {hi}, so go down to page {child}.
step.internalOpen: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}). Key {key} belongs to the branch starting at {lo} and above, so go down to page {child}.
step.internalNoRange: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}), then go down to page {child}. The key range of this branch is not in the pages read.
step.hidden: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}). This page is in the block of nodes not drawn, and key {key} goes into that block.
step.leafFound: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}). Key {key} is in this page, which holds {total, number} keys in all.
step.leafMissing: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}). The page holds {total, number} keys, and key {key} is not among the keys read.
step.heap: Step {n}: jump from the index to the heap and read page {page} to get the full row.
step.rangeStart: Step {n}: read page {page} ({kind}), the first leaf of the range. From here it moves sideways to the right-hand leaf, without going back to the root, until it meets a key greater than {to}. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read.
step.slide: Step {n}: slide to the right-hand leaf, page {page}, with {total, number} keys. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read.
step.heapRange: Step {n}: a leaf holds only keys and row locations. The first row of the range (key {key}) is on heap page {page}, so it jumps from the index to the heap to fetch the full row. The other rows need heap reads too; the animation shows the first row only.

idleRange: Not run yet. Press Run or Next step to see the range from {key} to {to}: the key drops to the first leaf, then slides right.
noPathRange: There is no path to the first leaf of the range in the data read (for example an index whose first column is DESC or NULLS FIRST, a text collation other than C, or a wrongly typed start key), so it cannot run. The tree is still shown correctly.

rangeError.badRange: The start key is greater than the end key, so the range is empty and there is nothing to read. Swap the two keys.
rangeError.badType: The end key does not match the key type of this index (numbers). Enter a number.
rangeError.multiColumn: The index has several columns. The range animation only supports single-column indexes for now, so it does not run.

end.done: Stop: the next leaf starts above {to} (or this leaf already has a larger key), so the range scan reads no more leaves. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read in total.
end.lastLeaf: Stop: this is the last leaf of the index, there is no leaf to the right. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read in total.
end.partial: Stop here: the next leaf has no key in the data read, so it is unknown whether it falls in the range. The rest is unread and not guessed. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read.
end.unread: Stop here: the next leaf has not been read into the tree. The rest of the range is unread, not drawn, and its page count is not guessed. {leaves, plural, one {# leaf} other {# leaves}} read.
